caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table with a rectangular top finished in a reddish-brown color, resembling mahogany or another dark wood. The table has rounded edges and rests on two vertically turned supports. At the center of the base, there is a decorative lyre-shaped element, featuring six parallel golden or yellow lines resembling strings, and intricate carvings. The entire table rests on four outwardly curved legs that end in ornate animal-like feet with golden tips. The table is centered on a plain, light beige background, and there is a small, cursive signature reading “J. Rothenberg” at the bottom right corner. No other objects or elements appear in the drawing.
title: Table (Lyre Pedestal)
